description: Data layer, no UI. Introduce the v2 data model, non-destructive v1->v2 migration, pure reducers/selectors, per-type encoders, quality rules, getRecordSvg accessor and useQrStore hook. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 (they may be done in any order after this, but the plan runs them in order). The existing v1 page src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.tsx must keep compiling and its 5 tests keep passing: rename the old record type to LegacyQrRecord in src/types/qrStudio.ts, keep loadQrRecords/saveQrRecords/QR_STUDIO_STORAGE_KEY (v1) untouched, and change only the import in QrStudioPage.tsx to `import { type LegacyQrRecord as QrRecord }` (no behavioural edit). The legacy exports are deleted later in FEAT-004. Review findings addressed here: MEDIUM 1 (source/needsLaunchConfirm/reducer transitions), NIT 3 (duplicate ids), NIT 5 (svg access enforcement), NIT 7 (V2_SVG_BUDGET_CHARS), plus carried-over: v2 storage key with v1 never written, corrupt-v1/corrupt-v2/quota handling, optional svg + getRecordSvg, Wi-Fi redaction.
steps: First run `git switch -c feat/qr-studio-refactor` if `git branch --show-current` is `main` (all FEATs commit on this branch; never push). Read context.json, .agents/tasks/design.md sections 2, 3 (quality rules), 5.2-5.4, 6.0, 6.1 and .agents/tasks/design-review.md findings 1, 3, 5, 7.

Rewrite src/types/qrStudio.ts to the design 2.1 v2 types: QrContentType with 12 values (url,text,wifi,contact,deep-link,app-link,email,phone,sms,location,event,custom), QrRecord (svg?: string optional, source?: 'created'|'decoded'|'imported' - the field is named `source`, never `origin` - folderId:string|null, tags:string[], notes, trashedAt, lastUsedAt?, fields?: QrFieldValues, favorite?), QrFolder, QrTag, QrTemplate, QrStudioState {schemaVersion:2, records, folders, tags, templates}, QrFieldValues discriminated union per type. Keep QrStyle, QrErrorCorrection, DEFAULT_QR_STYLE. Export the old v1 shape as LegacyQrRecord and patch the single import line in src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.tsx so it still compiles.

Extend src/services/qrStudioService.ts (keep parseMultiQrInput, styleQrSvg, qrFileName, v1 loadQrRecords/saveQrRecords): add QR_STUDIO_V2_STORAGE_KEY = 'scrcpy-gui-plus:qr-studio:v2', `const V2_SVG_BUDGET_CHARS = 2_500_000` (exported, compared against JSON.stringify(state).length), loadQrStudioState(storage) returning {state, readOnly, notice, persistError, dropped} and saveQrStudioState(storage, state) with try/catch quota handling, per design 2.2 steps 1, 2, 2a, 2b, 3. migrateV1(raw: unknown[]) keeps every object having string id/name/content, counts others in `dropped`, leaves missing svg undefined, merges style over DEFAULT_QR_STYLE, preserves createdAt/updatedAt, maps unknown contentType to 'custom', sets folderId:null, tags:[], notes:'', trashedAt:null, source:'imported', carries unknown extra fields through, seeds built-in templates (Classic, Inverted-safe, Navy, Coral, High contrast, Soft - design 4). NIT 3: on a duplicate id keep the first record and assign a fresh id (crypto.randomUUID with a Date/Math.random fallback, same style as createId in the old page) to later ones; never drop them. v1 raw string must stay byte-identical; corrupt v1 (invalid JSON or non-array) -> no v2 write, copy raw to `scrcpy-gui-plus:qr-studio:v1:corrupt-<timestamp>`, readOnly + 'Start fresh' action support; corrupt v2 or schemaVersion !== 2 -> backup key `...:v2:corrupt-<timestamp>`, readOnly. When the migrated payload exceeds V2_SVG_BUDGET_CHARS drop svg from the v2 copy only. Add getRecordSvg(record, opts?) as the ONLY accessor of a record's SVG: returns record.svg if present else generateQrSvg (from deepLinkService) + styleQrSvg through an in-memory LRU (300 entries, key contentType|content|errorCorrection, restyled per call); rejects on generation failure.

Create src/services/qrStudioStore.ts: pure reducers (saveRecord, saveMany, updateMeta (name/notes/folder/tags/favorite - never touches source), saveEditedFromCreate, duplicate, trash, restore (resets folderId to null if folder missing), deleteForever, emptyTrash, moveToFolder, createFolder/renameFolder (trimmed, <=40, case-insensitive unique, reserved names All/Uncategorized/Favorites/Recent/Trash rejected), deleteFolder (atomic: moves its records to folderId:null, never deletes records), addTag/renameTag/deleteTag (trim, 1-24 chars, no commas, case-insensitive dedupe keeping first casing, duplicate add returns existing tag, colliding rename rejected, delete removes id from all records), setTags, toggleFavorite, saveTemplate/renameTemplate/deleteTemplate (name <=40, case-insensitive unique, builtIn not deletable), markUsed(lastUsedAt)). MEDIUM 1 rule, exactly: export `const needsLaunchConfirm = (r: QrRecord) => r.source !== 'created'` (undefined => confirm). Transitions: new record from Create => source 'created'; records saved from Decoder/Capture flows => 'decoded'; saveEditedFromCreate preserves source unless content differs from the stored content, then sets 'created'; duplicate copies source; updateMeta/favorite/move/tag/trash never change source; unsaved Create draft has no record so no confirm. Also add selectors: selectRecords(state, {view: all|uncategorized|folder:id|favorites|recent|trash, query, types, tagIds (AND), sort: updated|created|name-asc|name-desc|type}) with stable id tie-break, typeCounts computed for current view+query excluding the type filter, Recent (lastUsedAt or updatedAt within 14 days, desc, max 50), All excludes Trash, and redactWifi(content) replacing the P: value with `P:••••` (search key uses the redacted form so passwords are never matchable; SSID stays searchable).

Create src/services/qrEncoders.ts per design 2.3: encode(fields) for every type returning {ok:true,content}|{ok:false,errors}, wifi escaping of \ ; , : " and ssid/password limits, email/phone/sms/location/event(CRLF, RFC 5545 escaping, end>start)/contact(vCard 3.0)/deep-link (same rule as Rust validate_uri)/app-link/url (http/https only)/text/custom; parseFields(contentType, content) inverse returning null when it cannot restore (Edit then opens as `custom`); detectType(content); estimateQrCapacity(content, ec) with byte limits L 2953, M 2331, Q 1663, H 1273; smsToViewUri(content) exactly per design 6.1 (number ^\+?[0-9]{3,20}$ else null; `sms:<num>?body=<encodeURIComponent(msg)>`, no query when empty; message may contain ':'); and a `launchableUri(record|content,type)` helper returning the URI to pass to launchDeepLink or null for wifi/contact/event/text/custom.

Create src/services/qrQuality.ts (pure, design 3): contrast via a colorContrast function moved from the old page (copy; the old page keeps its own copy until FEAT-004), warn <3, error <2, warn when foreground is lighter than background (inverted), size <256 warn, EC 'L' with content >60% capacity warn, content-length warns, optional round-trip result input; returns {level:'ok'|'warn'|'error', issues:[{code,message}]}.

Create src/components/qr-studio/useQrStore.ts: useReducer over QrStudioState seeded from loadQrStudioState(window.localStorage); persists in an effect debounced 250 ms with flush on beforeunload/unmount; exposes the actions above plus persistError, readOnly, notice, startFresh(); blocked writes while readOnly; never reports saved when setItem threw.

Tests (Vitest, jsdom): src/services/qrStudioService.test.ts (extend, keep the 3 existing tests): v1 record without svg survives; unknown extra fields kept; unknown contentType -> custom; second load does not re-migrate and v1 string is byte-identical; non-object/id-less entries counted in dropped; duplicate ids -> first kept, later get fresh unique ids, nothing dropped, count preserved; corrupt v1 `"{oops"` and `{"a":1}` -> empty state, readOnly, backup key, no v2 key; corrupt v2 and schemaVersion 3 -> backup + readOnly; throwing setItem -> state usable, persistError set, v1 unchanged, next load migrates again; payload over V2_SVG_BUDGET_CHARS -> v2 records have no svg, v1 untouched; getRecordSvg uses record.svg without calling the Tauri wrapper, generates when svg absent, rejects on failure. src/services/qrStudioStore.test.ts: folder CRUD incl. delete moves records to Uncategorized and keeps them, reserved/duplicate names, tags dedupe/rename collision/delete cleanup, trash/restore/restore with missing folder/empty trash, selectors (search name+content+notes+tag names, wifi password not matchable, type counts, stable sort, Recent, Favorites) and ALL MEDIUM 1 transitions (needsLaunchConfirm true for undefined/'imported'/'decoded', false for 'created'; edit without content change preserves source; edit in Create with changed content -> 'created'; duplicate copies source; updateMeta never changes source). src/services/qrEncoders.test.ts (every type incl. escape cases ; : \ non-ASCII SSID, parseFields round trips, detectType, capacity, smsToViewUri cases from design 6.1). src/services/qrQuality.test.ts. src/components/qr-studio/useQrStore.test.tsx (renderHook with fake timers: debounce, flush on unmount, readOnly blocks writes). NIT 5 enforcement test src/components/qr-studio/svgAccess.test.ts: read every non-test .ts/.tsx file under src/components/qr-studio with node:fs and assert none matches the regex /\.svg\b(?!['"`])/ (property access to a record's svg), with an explicit empty allowlist constant in the test; getRecordSvg in src/services/qrStudioService.ts is the only accessor (the regex excludes filename literals like 'x.svg' and `${n}.svg`). The test passes trivially now and guards later FEATs.
Run the verification commands; fix failures; commit with `git add` of the specific files and message `feat(qr-studio): v2 data model, migration, store, encoders`.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/services src/components/qr-studio src/components/pages/QrStudioPage.test.tsx` passes, including the 5 original page tests and 3 original service tests
Migration tests prove: v1 key byte-identical after migration, no v2 write on corrupt v1, duplicate ids preserved with fresh ids, quota failure leaves state usable with persistError
needsLaunchConfirm is the single one-line rule `r.source !== 'created'` and no identifier named `origin` exists in src/types/qrStudio.ts or src/services/qrStudioStore.ts
V2_SVG_BUDGET_CHARS = 2_500_000 is exported and compared with JSON.stringify(state).length
findings: Branch feat/qr-studio-refactor (from main). All verification passed: vitest scoped run 31 files/201 tests, tsc --noEmit 0, npm run build ok. Files: src/types/qrStudio.ts (v2 types + LegacyQrRecord), src/services/{qrStudioService,qrStudioStore,qrEncoders,qrQuality}.ts, src/components/qr-studio/{useQrStore.ts,svgAccess.test.ts,useQrStore.test.tsx}; QrStudioPage.tsx only changed its import to `type LegacyQrRecord as QrRecord`. API notes for later FEATs: (1) getRecordSvg(record, opts?:{style?}) ALWAYS returns the SVG styled (styleQrSvg with opts.style ?? record.style), whether it uses record.svg (v1 stored svg is the raw unstyled base) or generates; callers must not restyle again except to resize via opts.style. clearQrSvgCache() exported for tests. (2) Service exports: QR_STUDIO_V2_STORAGE_KEY, V2_SVG_BUDGET_CHARS, BUILT_IN_TEMPLATES (ids builtin-classic/-inverted-safe/-navy/-coral/-high-contrast/-soft), createQrId, emptyQrStudioState, migrateV1, loadQrStudioState(storage:{getItem,setItem}) -> {state,readOnly,notice,persistError,dropped} (load itself writes v2 after migrating), saveQrStudioState(storage,state) -> {ok:true}|{ok:false,error}. When over budget, svg is dropped from the migrated in-memory/v2 state. (3) qrStudioStore reducers are pure `(state, ...args) => state` for plain ops and StoreResult<T> ({ok,state,value}|{ok:false,state,error}) for createFolder/renameFolder/addTag/renameTag/saveTemplate/renameTemplate/duplicate. saveRecord(state, NewRecordInput{source? default 'created'}, now?). saveMany takes inputs (pass source:'decoded' from Decoder/Capture flows). updateMeta touches updatedAt (not toggleFavorite/markUsed). saveEditedFromCreate drops stored svg unless content, contentType and EC unchanged. Views: 'all'|'uncategorized'|'favorites'|'recent'|'trash'|`folder:${id}`; SelectOptions has an injectable `now` (ms) for Recent. typeCounts returns {total, byType} and applies view+query+tagIds (excludes only the type filter). Recent ignores the sort option (always recency desc). redactWifi redacts any content starting with WIFI:. (4) useQrStore returns {state, persistError, readOnly, notice, dismissNotice, startFresh, ...actions}; actions return ActionResult<T> ({ok:true,value}|{ok:false,error}) and are blocked (ok:false) while readOnly; saveRecord returns the new id. Persistence is debounced 250 ms (PERSIST_DEBOUNCE_MS) from an effect, flushed on beforeunload/unmount; a failed write keeps the state dirty and sets persistError (cleared on next successful write). In tests wrap state-changing calls and timer advances in separate act() calls (the persist timer is armed in an effect). (5) qrEncoders exports encode, parseFields, detectType, estimateQrCapacity -> {bytes,limit,ratio,fits}, smsToViewUri, launchableUri(sourceOrRecord, type?), validateUri, QR_BYTE_LIMITS. Event fields: timed start/end are anything Date parses (e.g. datetime-local 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm', interpreted as local, emitted as UTC); allDay uses 'YYYY-MM-DD' and requires end strictly after start (DTEND exclusive). parseFields(event) returns local 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm'. url type auto-prefixes https:// when no scheme and normalises via URL.href (adds trailing '/'). Wi-Fi hidden emits H:true only when hidden. (6) qrQuality exports assessQrQuality(input{content,foreground,background,size,errorCorrection,roundTrip?:'verified'|'mismatch'|'undecodable'}) -> {level,issues:[{code,message,level}]}, colorContrast, relativeLuminance. Codes: color-invalid, contrast-critical(<2 error), contrast-low(<3 warn), inverted, size-small, content-empty(error), capacity-exceeded(error), ec-low-dense, content-long(>1000 bytes warn), roundtrip-mismatch(error), roundtrip-undecodable(warn). (7) svgAccess.test.ts reads sources with Vite import.meta.glob ?raw (tsconfig has no node types, @types/node is not in tsconfig `types`), not node:fs. It scans all non-test .ts/.tsx under src/components/qr-studio for /\.svg\b(?!['"`])/; later FEATs must go through getRecordSvg (do not write `x.svg` property access or the word `.svg` followed by a non-quote in those files, including comments). (8) Nothing in types/store uses the identifier `origin`. No Rust/Cargo changes. No new npm dependency.
